info.title: Mocó Internal Operations API
info.description:
Process probes, deployment-scoped authorization administration, and a
restricted request audit ledger for security observability. The audit
operation is not a reconciliation/change feed; controllers and operators
use the public watch endpoint and relist contract for convergence. A
bounded local retention operation removes events before an operator-supplied
cutoff without changing public resource history.
The encryption operations report the shared root-key state and perform
bounded online rewraps of vault data keys under the configured active
root-key era; key material is supplied only by deployment configuration and
is never accepted or returned by this API.
Administrative operations are intended for a restricted deployment origin;
they never expose bearer token digests or request payloads.

servers.description: Direct deployment origin, normally restricted by network policy.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Process liveness and traffic readiness probes.

tags.name: Authorization
tags.description: Restricted replacement of the persisted authorization snapshot.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Restricted request metadata ledger for security observability; not a reconciliation feed.

tags.name: Encryption
tags.description: Restricted root-key status and bounded rewrap maintenance; never accepts or returns key material.

get.description: Returns 200 while the server process can handle HTTP requests.

Returns 200 when the instance can serve product traffic and 503 otherwise.
The body deliberately omits dependency and configuration details.

200.description: Instance is ready for product traffic.

503.description: Instance is not ready for product traffic.

get.description: Returns the complete role-binding and policy snapshot without token digests. The ETag is the authoritative snapshot revision. A policy's optional secretPathPrefix narrows the decoded logical path or prefix query value for a secret item, metadata, or collection route and is a literal prefix match.

put.description: Atomically replaces all role bindings and policies when If-Match identifies the revision observed by the writer. A committed change signals local reloaders and is discovered by shared-store polling in other processes. Set secretPathPrefix only on a policy for a canonical secret operation route; policies without it remain vault-scoped.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong ETag returned by the latest GET or PUT response. Use `*` to apply against the revision observed immediately before this request.

requestBody.description: Complete replacement snapshot; empty arrays mean default-deny.

get.description: Returns request metadata in ascending durable sequence order for security observability. Successful mutations and their event commit in one SQLite transaction before the success response; failed audit or commit rolls back the mutation. Startup metadata initialization uses a synthetic STARTUP event with route /internal/startup and principal system:startup. Read-only and rejected attempts are recorded independently after their response and may be missing on audit failure. This is not a reconciliation or change-feed operation; controllers and operators must use the public watch endpoint and relist contract for convergence. Query strings, request bodies, bearer credentials, and plaintext logical secret paths are never returned; secret paths are represented only by keyed HMAC-SHA-256 digests. Reads from this endpoint are not themselves recorded, so a tailing client cannot create self-events. The endpoint is internal and requires an explicit authorization policy for its exact path.

post.description: Deletes at most 200 audit events strictly older than the required cutoff; destructive requests require a cutoff at least one hour old. This is local deployment maintenance, not a public resource mutation. Set dryRun=true to preview the current matching count without deleting anything, including with a more recent past cutoff; a dry-run result is informational, not a convergence loop. For a delete, repeat the same cutoff until complete is true and remaining is zero; the count is not a snapshot and newly inserted events can change it. Sequence numbers remain monotonic, the public resource-watch revision is unchanged, and event contents, credentials, plaintext secret paths, and key material are never accepted or returned. The endpoint requires an explicit exact-path POST policy and should be restricted to a deployment origin.

post.summary: Rewrap one bounded page of vault data keys
post.description: Rewraps persisted vault data keys whose root key ID is not the configured active era. The active and previous root keys are loaded from deployment configuration; this operation never accepts, returns, or logs key material. Repeating a page is safe. Use both returned keyset checkpoints to continue when hasMore is true, then run a fresh sweep until complete is true and remainingOldKeys is zero. The server persists an encryption-key epoch and rejects stale processes; the expected active ID and epoch are revalidated atomically in each key replacement, so all writers must start with the current epoch before maintenance. Rotation changes only wrapped-key bytes, not secret ciphertext, resource versions, or API representations, and may be run concurrently by workers in the same epoch.

get.description: Reads the current shared root-key era, deployment epoch, and count of vault keys still using an older era. The result is a point-in-time diagnostic, not a lock or a snapshot; it never accepts or returns key material, plaintext, ciphertext, or secret paths. Use it to coordinate bounded POST /internal/v1/encryption/rotation pages and remove an old deployment key only after a fresh sweep reports complete=true and remainingOldKeys=0. A concurrent writer or rotation worker can change the result immediately.

bearerAuth.description: Deployment-issued bearer credential for restricted operations.

health-status.title: HealthStatus
health-status.description: Minimal probe result with no deployment details.

unavailable-status.title: UnavailableStatus
unavailable-status.description: Minimal readiness failure with no dependency details.

authorization-snapshot.title: AuthorizationSnapshot
authorization-snapshot.description: Persisted authorization state; token digests are intentionally omitted.

revision.description: Monotonic snapshot revision used by ETag and optimistic concurrency.

authorization-snapshot-input.title: AuthorizationSnapshotInput
authorization-snapshot-input.description: Complete replacement snapshot; empty arrays intentionally mean default-deny.

authorization-role-binding.title: AuthorizationRoleBinding
authorization-role-binding.description: Principal-to-role binding scoped to one authorization domain.

authorization-policy.title: AuthorizationPolicy
authorization-policy.description: Allow policy for a role or principal, domain, path pattern, and HTTP method. Secret operation policies may additionally narrow access to a literal logical secret path prefix.

secretPathPrefix.description: Literal logical secret path prefix. Only valid when path is the secret item, secret metadata, or secret collection route; the decoded path/prefix query value must begin with this prefix. An empty collection prefix is not authorized for a path-scoped policy. The reserved value '*' preserves legacy vault-wide behavior.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Problem Details response compatible with RFC 9457.

type.description: Stable documentation URI for this problem type.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable error code. Implementations currently use
unauthorized, forbidden, invalid_request, invalid_json,
invalid_content_type, invalid_request_id, validation_failed,
invalid_if_match, invalid_if_none_match, invalid_cursor, cursor_expired,
invalid_resource_version, invalid_watch_timeout, resource_version_ahead,
resource_not_found,
resource_conflict, resource_has_children, idempotency_key_conflict,
etag_mismatch, secret_too_large, invalid_rotation_checkpoint,
invalid_limit, encryption_key_epoch_conflict, service_unavailable,
and internal_error.

detail.description: Human-readable detail that never contains secret values.
detail.example: The requested resource does not exist.

requestId.description: Correlation identifier also returned in X-Request-ID.

resourceId.description: Existing resource ID when safely useful for conflict recovery.

example.message: must match the documented name format

problem-error.title: ProblemError
problem-error.description: Field-specific validation failure safe to expose to clients.

field.description: JSON Pointer or parameter name when the failure has a location.

message.description: Human-readable message that never contains secret values.
message.example: must match the documented name format

audit-event-list.title: AuditEventList
audit-event-list.description: Ordered page from the append-only audit ledger.

hasMore.description: Whether another event exists after the last returned sequence.

nextAfterSequence.description: Exclusive checkpoint for the next page; null when hasMore is false.

audit-event.title: AuditEvent
audit-event.description: Request audit metadata without request bodies, query strings, credentials, or plaintext secret paths.

principalId.description: Authenticated principal identifier; absent when authentication did not succeed.

route.description: Request path without its query string.

secretPathSha256.description: Keyed HMAC-SHA-256 digest of the decoded logical secret path or list prefix; the plaintext is never persisted and the deployment key is never returned.

audit-retention-result.title: AuditRetentionResult
audit-retention-result.description: Bounded local audit retention result. It contains no event contents; remaining is a current diagnostic rather than a historical snapshot.

before.description: Normalized UTC cutoff used by the retention batch.

deleted.description: Number of events deleted by this bounded request.

remaining.description: Current number of events strictly before the cutoff; this is not a snapshot.

hasMore.description: Whether another bounded retention request is needed for the cutoff.

complete.description: True when no event currently remains before the cutoff.

dryRun.description: True when the request only measured the matching count and made no deletion.

encryption-rotation-result.description: Bounded root-key rewrap result. It contains counts and a keyset checkpoint only; no key material or secret data is returned.

activeRootKeyId.description: Identifier of the deployment key era used for new and rewrapped vault keys.

activeRootKeyEpoch.description: Monotonic deployment epoch that fences stale server processes during rollout.

skipped.description: Keys already using the active era or changed by another worker before this request committed.

complete.description: True when no vault key currently uses an older root-key era. A fresh full sweep should be run after transient failures or concurrent maintenance.

nextAfterTenantId.description: Checkpoint for the next page; null when hasMore is false.

nextAfterVaultId.description: Checkpoint for the next page; null when hasMore is false.

remainingOldKeys.description: Current count of vault keys whose root key ID differs from the active era; this is not a snapshot.

encryption-rotation-status.title: EncryptionRotationStatus
encryption-rotation-status.description: Current shared root-key rotation state. Counts are point-in-time diagnostics, not a lock or a snapshot; no key material is returned.

activeRootKeyId.description: Identifier of the deployment key era currently recorded in the shared store.

activeRootKeyEpoch.description: Monotonic deployment epoch currently recorded in the shared store.

remainingOldKeys.description: Current count of vault keys whose root-key ID differs from the active era; this is not a snapshot.

complete.description: True when no persisted vault key currently uses an older root-key era.

unauthorized.description: Bearer authentication is missing or invalid.

forbidden.description: The authenticated principal lacks permission for the operation.

internal-error.description: The server failed to complete the request.

service-unavailable.description:
The service or a required dependency is temporarily unavailable. This may be
emitted by Mocó or by the deployment edge; clients should retry after the
advertised interval with bounded exponential backoff.

bad-request.description: Request parameters, headers, or body are invalid.

precondition-failed.description: A conditional request header does not match current resource state.

conflict.description:
The request conflicts with current resource state, a uniqueness constraint,
existing children, or a prior idempotency-key body. Uniqueness conflicts set
`resourceId` when the existing resource can be identified safely; clients
may use it to adopt rather than create a duplicate.

request-id.name: X-Request-ID
request-id.description: Optional caller correlation ID; the server returns the effective ID.

audit-after-sequence.name: afterSequence
audit-after-sequence.description: Exclusive audit sequence checkpoint. Use the returned nextAfterSequence to continue the same ordered ledger page.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

audit-before.name: before
audit-before.description: Delete events strictly older than this UTC cutoff. The cutoff must be at least one hour old for deletion. Repeat the same cutoff until the response reports complete=true; use dryRun=true to preview without deleting.

audit-dry-run.name: dryRun
audit-dry-run.description: Preview the current matching count without deleting events. A dry-run result is informational and must not be repeated as a convergence loop.

encryption-after-tenant-id.name: afterTenantId
encryption-after-tenant-id.description: Exclusive tenant identifier checkpoint returned with the preceding rotation page. Supply it together with afterVaultId.

encryption-after-vault-id.name: afterVaultId
encryption-after-vault-id.description: Exclusive vault identifier checkpoint returned with the preceding rotation page. Supply it together with afterTenantId.

retry-after.description: Delay in seconds before retrying the request.

etag.description:
Opaque strong validator for conditional requests. The value is a quoted
entity-tag; clients must treat it as opaque and send the complete value back.
`If-Match` accepts one or more strong tags or `*`; `If-None-Match` accepts a
comma-separated list (including weak tags) for reads and only `*` for PUT.

www-authenticate.description: Authentication challenge for a bearer credential.
